sources_used: Wikipedia geosearch (API) around the village, Tasman Valley and Lake Pukaki

gaps.name: Kea Point
sources: Wikivoyage park page (mentions Kea Point Track parking)
gaps.reason: DOC-promoted short walk from the village to a viewing deck; a classic second-tier stop.

gaps.name: Sealy Tarns
gaps.reason: Own Wikipedia article and DOC track (3-4 hr return); distinct from Mueller Hut, which is a further route beyond.

gaps.name: Red Tarns
gaps.reason: DOC walking track (2 hr return) from the village to a viewing deck; no Wikipedia article, so wiki null.

gaps.name: Governors Bush Walk
gaps.reason: DOC short walk and the sheltered bad-weather option; low rank. Proposed with null photo.

gaps.name: Blue Lakes / Blue Lake (Canterbury)
gaps.reason: Same walk and viewpoint as the existing Tasman Glacier spot, about 400 m away; duplicate.

gaps.name: Hooker Lake / Hooker Glacier
gaps.reason: The end of the Hooker Valley Track, already a spot; duplicate.

gaps.name: Mueller Glacier / Mueller Lake lookout
gaps.reason: Seen from Kea Point and Red Tarns; only a viewpoint, no separate visitor destination.

gaps.name: Mount Ollivier / Mount Sefton / other peaks
gaps.reason: Mountaineering objectives rather than visitor stops; seen from the walks above.

gaps.name: Mount Cook Village
gaps.reason: It is the destination's base and centre; the Hermitage and Alpine Centre already cover it.

gaps.name: Bowen Bush Walk, Glencoe Walk
gaps.reason: 10-minute village strolls that only locals and overnight guests walk; Bowen joins Governors Bush.

gaps.name: Ball Pass, Ball Hut Track, Copland Pass, Hooker Hut
gaps.reason: Mountaineering routes needing alpine experience; rarely visited by ordinary travellers.

gaps.name: Mount Cook Airport, Glentanner Park, Heliworks
gaps.reason: Aerodrome, campground and flight operators; vehicles/operators, not places. The glacier landing is covered by the Tasman Glacier spot.

gaps.name: Peter's Lookout (Tapataia Mahaka), Lake Pukaki Visitor Centre and Mt Cook Alpine Salmon
gaps.reason: Viewpoint and stops at the south end of Lake Pukaki, 40-50 km from the centre, outside 75% of the 50 km span (37.5 km); they are part of the Lake Pukaki experience, already a spot.

gaps.name: Alps 2 Ocean Cycle Trail
gaps.reason: A 300 km cycle trail, not a place here; the village is only its start. Handle as a standalone or country-level item.

gaps.name: Twizel
gaps.reason: About 58 km away, beyond the span, and a separate base (DOC calls it the nearest town). Flag for the Mackenzie Basin run as a possible destination or standalone spot, along with Lake Ruataniwha view point, Lake Ohau and Omarama Clay Cliffs.

gaps.name: Lake Tekapo area, Church of the Good Shepherd
gaps.reason: Already the Lake Tekapo destination, about 55 km away.

gaps.name: Hooker Valley Track suspension bridges, Alpine Memorial, Mueller Lake Lookout
gaps.reason: Features on the Hooker Valley Track and village paths; not separate stops.
